## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) notices [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) dressed up and driving away from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), sparking her curiosity. She visits [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate and learns that the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) are adopting an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). Mrs. Rachel voices strong disapproval and warnings about the risks of adoption before taking her leave.
>

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but offends the girl by rudely criticizing her appearance. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flies into a furious temper outburst at Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to send her to her room and demand an apology that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stubbornly refuses to give.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who forgives her completely and gives her flowers. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a warm surge of affection for the girl despite her theatrical nature.
>

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off. Later at home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) laughs heartily after finding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imagined future where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea and treat her to raspberry cordial. While playing hostess at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally serves [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) three glasses of Marilla's homemade currant wine instead of cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to get dizzy and sick. After [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) leaves, Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of getting her daughter drunk and forbids them from playing together, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes the mistake.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed and accidentally jump on Diana's elderly [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious and threatening to leave.
>

> After speaking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Anne's honest confession and imaginative defense amuse Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), convincing her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) become good friends throughout the rest of her visit.
>

> During a party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts Josie Pye's dare to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in a fall that breaks her ankle. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as the injured girl is brought home, and during her weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys visits from friends while eagerly anticipating returning to school under their new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shares her school activities with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), including plans for an upcoming Christmas concert. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the festivities, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his warm encouragement.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) realizes that Anne's plain clothes set her apart from other girls, so he decides to buy her a fashionable dress for Christmas. After an awkward attempt to shop at Lawson's store, he gets Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to buy and sew a brown dress with puffed sleeves for her. On Christmas morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), along with slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), and she goes on to star in the successful evening concert.
>

> As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures her students that she will return next year to prepare them for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to spend her summer vacation playing and letting her imagination run free. Meanwhile, [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea and praises [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown and improved over the past three years.
>

> After finishing school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in town, staying with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Weeks later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the official results showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the Island. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the triumphant news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before ending her evening with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns that she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal at Queen's. After Commencement, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), catches up with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and notices concerning signs about Matthew's and Marilla's health, as well as worries about their bank.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies from the shock of reading about the Abbey Bank failure. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) grieve together and carry out Matthew's funeral with the support of neighbors. Afterwards, life slowly resumes at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to visit an eye specialist while chatting with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about past memories.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns with bad news about her failing sight, prompting her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolutely gives up her college scholarship to stay home, save Marilla's eyes, and teach locally. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) reveals that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could have it, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert to finally reconcile their rivalry and become good friends.
>
